note: Borough election, 20 May 1964: one alderman and the councillors for each of the three wards. The returning officer's notice of result (John Simpson, returning officer, dated 21 May 1964; Ballymena Observer, 28 May 1964, p. 4) gives both tables. Aldermen: Harryville and Market were returned without a poll; Town Hall was polled, T. H. R. Dowzer defeating W. C. Craig. Councillors: Harryville was polled for four seats (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1964, p. 7, with the notice's figures); four Market and three Town Hall councillors were returned without a poll. The one-seat Town Hall contest earlier filed as a councillor vacancy is the aldermanic election and is filed as such. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
